note: Passages only, of a 25,036-word review dated October 2024. It says LHIMS is being implemented nationwide as an electronic medical record system and that monthly reports go to DHIMS2 as statutory reporting, but states no tier, no place of data entry, no clinic count, no owner, no finance and no dated event for either, so nothing fits an aspect's closed list. It calls for a national digital health policy and a cross-cutting sector digital strategy while also saying the HISSP was developed, so no plan value is taken. rsLog is classed tracker on its one-programme client data; the passage does not say whether it is patient-level.
